title: 第1706章 大冤种第1705章 小鬼难缠
lines: 一处摊位前。
黑天说道：“他是一位仙君强者，专门走私各种精血，不过价格方面有些贵，你要做好心理准备。”
林铮点点头，他当然明白黑天的意思。
对于林铮来说，只要能够买到合适的精血，仙石根本不是问题。
在林铮看来，仙石本身就是身外之物，能够换取到对自己有用的东西，才是最好的选择，要不然的话，自己身上的仙石再多又有何用，毫无意义的事情。
摊位上摆放着各种玉瓶，一个个玉瓶上挂着一块块玉牌，上面写着各种精血介绍。
“各位需要什么。”
“是否有仙君精血和仙王精血。”
听到有仙王精血出售，林铮显得很是惊讶，说道：“你有多少。”
“我有多少，取决于你能买多少。”
“只要价格合理，你有多少精血，我全部都能买下。”
听到此话的黑天和轻灵显得很是惊讶，毕竟他们认为林铮实在是有些太过大话，要是对方真的拿出足够多的精血怎么办。
地摊老板笑了笑，一挥手，一个个酒坛大小的玉瓶出现，足足有着上百个，说道：“这里面全部都是仙王精血，价格在上面，你要是全部能够买下，我可以给你打九折。”
林铮大概算了算，的确是个庞大数字，不过现在的他急需要精血，等到自己能够炼制成涅盘丹，相信出售的仙石数量，要是自己掏出去的仙石上百倍不止。
丹药生意，无论走到哪里都是最暴力的买卖。
林铮点点头，说道：“价格有些虚高，不过没有关系，我全部买了。”
看到林铮真的支付仙石，不管是轻灵还是黑天都更加震惊起来，原本想要阻止，不过他们能看的出来，林铮很明显是来真的。
地摊老板虽然是仙君武者，不过也是说话算数，打完折后，将所有仙王精血全部卖给林铮。
“你的仙君精血，还有其他精血一并全部卖给我。”
“你能吃得下吗？”
“没问题。”
地摊老板当然不会拒绝，这么好的买卖怎么可能拒绝。
“我想问问，你手里是否有着仙尊精血。”
这才是林铮真正想要购买的东西，因为他之前拍下和得到的仙尊精血，并未让他顺利炼制出八品涅盘丹。
正是因为如此，在林铮看来，自己要是想继续参悟八品涅盘丹，则是需要更多的仙尊精血。
“有是有，但仙尊精血的价格。”
“只要你有，价格方面不是问题。”
地摊老板也没有多余的废话，今天好不容易遇到个大买主，肯定不会轻易错失，立刻拿出所谓的仙尊精血。
“这些都是仙尊精血？”
“没错。”
林铮看着面前的仙尊精血，也是感到惊讶不已，因为他实在是没有想到，地摊老板不单单是有着仙王精血，甚至还拿出这么多的仙尊精血，价格更是仙王精血的十倍，一般人还真是买不起。
“打个折。”
“八折，不要和我讨价还价。”
林铮点点头，他很清楚地摊老板能给自己打个八折已经算是很不错了，立刻拿出仙石卡支付，没有丝毫的拖泥带水，生怕对方后悔。
黑天实在是忍不住了，走上来小声说道：“林兄弟，恕我直言，这些所谓的精血，很明显已经没有多大的用处，你就算是购买回去吞噬，对于武道修炼起不到任何的作用。”
content_en:
In front of a stall.
Heitian said: "He is a powerful Immortal Lord who specializes in smuggling various blood essences, but the price is a bit expensive, so you have to be mentally prepared."
Lin Zheng nodded, of course he understood what Heitian meant.
For Lin Zheng, as long as he can buy the right blood essence, immortal stones are not a problem at all.
In Lin Zheng's view, the immortal stones themselves are external objects. The best choice is to exchange them for something useful to him. Otherwise, no matter how many immortal stones he has on his body, it is of no use. It is meaningless.
There are various jade bottles placed on the stall, and each jade bottle is hung with a piece of jade plaque, with various introductions to blood essence written on it.
"What do you need?"
"Is there any essence and blood of the Immortal Lord and the Immortal King?"
"Yes."
Hearing that the blood of the Immortal King was for sale, Lin Zheng looked very surprised and said, "How much do you have?"
"How much I have depends on how much you can buy."
"As long as the price is reasonable, I can buy it all, no matter how much essence and blood you have."
Heitian and Qingling were very surprised when they heard this. After all, they thought Lin Zheng was talking too much. What if the other party really gave out enough blood and essence.
The stall owner smiled, waved his hand, and jade bottles the size of wine jars appeared one after another. There were hundreds of them, and he said: "These are all the essence and blood of the Immortal King. The price is above. If you can buy them all, I can give you a 10% discount."
Lin Zheng did some calculations and found that it was indeed a huge number, but now he was in urgent need of blood essence. When he could refine the Nirvana Pill, he believed that the number of immortal stones sold would be hundreds of times more than the immortal stones he took out.
The elixir business is the most violent business no matter where you go.
Lin Zheng nodded and said: "The price is a bit high, but it doesn't matter, I bought them all."
Seeing that Lin Zheng really paid for the immortal stone, both Qing Ling and Heitian were even more shocked. They originally wanted to stop him, but they could see that Lin Zheng was obviously serious.
Although the stall owner was an Immortal King warrior, he kept his word. After discounting, he sold all the Immortal King essence and blood to Lin Zheng.
"Sell me all your Immortal Lord essence and blood, as well as other essences and blood."
"Can you eat it?"
"No problem."
Of course the stall owner would not refuse. How could he refuse such a good deal?
"I want to ask if you have the essence and blood of the Immortal Lord in your hand."
This is what Lin Zheng really wants to buy, because the blood essence and blood of the Immortal Lord that he took and obtained before did not allow him to successfully refine the eighth-grade Nirvana Pill.
It is precisely because of this that, in Lin Zheng's view, if he wants to continue to comprehend the eighth-grade Nirvana Pill, he will need more essence and blood of the Immortal Lord.
"Yes, there is, but the price of Immortal Lord's essence and blood is high."
"As long as you have it, price is not a problem."
The street stall owner didn't have any unnecessary nonsense. He finally met a big buyer today, and he would definitely not miss it easily. He immediately took out the so-called immortal essence and blood.
"Is this all the essence and blood of the Immortal Lord?"
"That's right."
Lin Zheng was surprised when he looked at the Immortal King's essence and blood in front of him, because he really didn't expect that the street stall owner not only had the Immortal King's essence and blood, but also gave out so much of the Immortal King's essence and blood. The price was ten times that of the Immortal King's essence and blood. Most people really couldn't afford it.
"Get a discount."
"20% off, don't bargain with me."
Lin Zheng nodded. He knew very well that the 20% discount the stall owner could give him was pretty good. He immediately took out his Immortal Stone Card to pay without any hesitation, for fear that the other party would regret it.
Heitian couldn't bear it anymore and walked up and whispered: "Brother Lin, with all due respect, these so-called blood essences are obviously of little use anymore. Even if you buy them back and devour them, they will not have any effect on martial arts practice."
